name: Prefecture Pikemen
headerMeta: Silver era · Pike/Polearm infantry · anti-cav · 165 leadership · T3 Tier
pitch: A cost-effective anti-cavalry line held by pike bracing and lifesteal damage. Weak in a solo fight without setup, so position behind allies and wait for raid glow before committing.

doctrines.name: Mobility Doctrine V
doctrines.effect: +7% movement speed, unlocks Sprint: +15% movement speed for 12s.

doctrines.name: Epic Bloodthirsty Doctrine
doctrines.effect: 12% lifesteal for 6s after dealing damage, +12% DMG when HP above 60%.

battleRole.positioning: Position one pike-length behind your front line. Wait for raid glow before charging; time the charge so the brace lands as enemies engage {1}.
battleRole.tips: Charge, then press 2 after impact. Try to disengage and reset for another cycle; if pinned, sacrifice the unit rather than die in place. Expect slower mobility even with Sprint — avoid leading attacks into prepared defenses.

numbers.label: Post-charge passive (early hits)
numbers.value: ~3,000 dmg per hit, first few hits after charge (2021 testing, unverified vs current patch)

controls.notes: Set F3 Column formation to access hero buffs. Engage on raid-glow call; brace (1 → V) to trigger anti-cavalry mitigation, then press 2 (ability) on impact. Disengage and reset position after each cycle.

A SuperKitowiec video guide (2021-07-16) calls this unit a 'pike unit without brace' driven entirely by its charge - this conflicts with the pitch/tips/controls text above ('pike bracing', 'brace (1 -> V)'). Flagged here for a vet re-check rather than silently resolved. {2}

The same source adds more color not folded into the matchups/battle-role text above: bad vs shields ('very small block break'), decent vs Berserkers, a Season 8 buff to charge/turning speed/hitbox plus a new passive ('Three Bristles', unconfirmed - see numbers), and two engine quirks - a post-charge freeze, and a stronger 'Push Off Pike' wedge-charge variant that only fires in proper wedge formation. {2}
